name: Required Submission 4
definition: Specifies the details relative to the submission of the certificate data set.

Submitter.name: Submitter
Submitter.definition: Specifies with party(ies) is authorised to submit the data set as part of the transaction.

CertificateType.name: Certificate Type
CertificateType.definition: Specifies the type of the certificate.

MatchIssuer.name: Match Issuer
MatchIssuer.definition: Specifies if the issuer must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.

MatchIssueDate.name: Match Issue Date
MatchIssueDate.definition: Specifies if the issue date must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.

MatchInspectionDate.name: Match Inspection Date
MatchInspectionDate.definition: Specifies if the inspection date must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.

AuthorisedInspectorIndicator.name: Authorised Inspector Indicator
AuthorisedInspectorIndicator.definition: Specifies if the indication of an authorised inspector must be present as part of the validation of the data set.

MatchConsignee.name: Match Consignee
MatchConsignee.definition: Specifies if the consignee must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.

MatchManufacturer.name: Match Manufacturer
MatchManufacturer.definition: Specifies if the manufacturer must be matched as part of the validation of the data set.

LineItemIdentification.name: Line Item Identification
LineItemIdentification.definition: Specifies if the certificate data set is required in relation to specific line items, and which line items.
